searchText: Onboarding builders at the fork Going forward with Gloas, Should we deprecate JSON support in the builder-api and only support SSZ objects? https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/issues/124 The execution payload bid and beacon block should be much smaller objects with Gloas and I am not sure if i see any major savings in terms of bandwidth involved in not using json.

excerpts.content:
Going forward with Gloas, Should we deprecate JSON support in the builder-api and only support SSZ objects?  https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/issues/124
The execution payload bid and beacon block should be much smaller objects with Gloas and I am not sure if i see any major savings in terms of bandwidth involved in not using json.
